Container.Name: habitbook
Container.Overview: Habitbook is an iOS-style habit tracker PWA: a monthly spread with memorable moments, colour-coded habits, weight, a sleep chart and a gratitude journal. Accounts sync your book across devices, and an Apple Health import works through iOS Shortcuts. The first account you create becomes the admin.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port to open Habitbook on.

Config.Name: Allow sign-ups
Config.Description: true lets anyone who can reach the server create an account. false means only the admin adds users.
